description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the CandidateAttachment entity in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It sets up test data, creates a CandidateAttachment object, populates its fields, persists it, and asserts its correct retrieval and properties.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for verifying the CandidateAttachment entity functionality within the OrangeHRM recruitment system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the CandidateAttachment table and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testCandidateAttachmentEntity
